name: Sushi Bar Fresh Salmon Nigiri (Sake - Fresh Raw Salmon over White Rice)
whyItWorks: High-grade fresh raw Atlantic salmon draped over a finger of seasoned white sushi rice. Rich in anti-inflammatory marine omega-3 fatty acids (EPA/DHA) that help resolve mucosal irritation. Soft, tender, and requires minimal digestive effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Salmon Nigiri (Sake)—Sabi-nuki (NO wasabi inside). Please serve with gluten-free tamari.'
